content:
alex k: Morning team — first day on site! Monitor arrived but dock isn't enumerating USB devices on my MacBook, only display works. Also seeing intermittent Wi-Fi drops (No Internet) every ~10-15m. I filed a ticket earlier but no updates yet. Who should I poke for dongle/office network help?
IT Helpdesk: Welcome, alex! Can you confirm the dock model and macOS version? Also paste output of `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` and `ifconfig en0` (or en1 on M-series).
alex k: Dock is PlugPlus 8-in-1, macOS 13.4.1 (Intel). Pasting trimmed outputs: ```/AppleUSBHostMergeProperties/PlugPlus upstream: Not available
AppleUSBHub: Hub found, no child devices``` and `en0: flags=8863 mtu 1500 inet 10.0.22.45 netmask 0xffffff00 
`
IT Helpdesk: Looks like the dock enumerates but USB hub children aren't showing. Two quick checks: 1) try a direct laptop->dock upstream cable if available, 2) System Settings -> Network -> Renew DHCP Lease for the Wi-Fi drops. I'll open a hardware follow-up ticket. If you can, try another USB-C cable (some cables are power-only).
IT Delivery: FYI tracking on the spare USB-C dongle shows shipped via ShipFast, tracking SF482019; expected delivery 2026-03-25. If IT confirms defective we'll expedite.
maria (mgr): @alex k good to see you! For now you can plug into the B2 conference room wired port if wifi keeps acting up. Ping me if you need access to any internal tools.
joanne: Quick workaround that helped another new hire: plug the monitor upstream directly into laptop USB-C (bypass dock) — get display + some USB devices. Also try System Settings > Network > Advanced > TCP/IP > Renew DHCP Lease.
it-ticket-bot: Created ticket INF-2026-4820 (Hardware: Dock USB failure) and linked to your original case. Assigned to IT Helpdesk, priority: Standard.
alex k: Tried renew DHCP and direct upstream cable: renew stabilized Wi-Fi for ~30m so far. Direct upstream gave display + keyboard but external webcam still not detected. Will wait on the dongle but if the dock is confirmed faulty can we request an express swap?
IT Helpdesk: Thanks for the checks. I've marked INF-2026-4820 as hardware-swap-pending and requested expedited replacement if QA replicates. Tagging @IT Delivery to confirm shipping ETA. :thumbsup:
IT Delivery: Noted — if QA marks DOA we'll ship next-business-day express.
alex k: Awesome, thanks all. Leaving notes here in case anyone picks it up after lunch. Appreciate the quick responses! :smiley:
